summary.text: Backend engineer with 2+ years of experience building data-intensive Python services, async pipelines and ML-backed APIs.

bullets.text: Built a Django and Celery workflow platform that orchestrates parallel data ingestion, analysis and report generation, cutting portfolio report turnaround from 3 hours to under 60 seconds.
Designed monthly Apache Iceberg partitioning on AWS S3 for 15+ years of market data, reducing partitions from 5,000+ daily to ~180 monthly while keeping date-range pruning.
Developed a Kafka-based ingestion pipeline loading financial datasets into MinIO across 25+ topics and 800+ partitions for downstream analytics.
Added Prometheus and Grafana dashboards for the ingestion services, tracking consumer lag and p99 latency across 1,000+ daily jobs.
Built REST APIs in FastAPI for an internal document search tool, serving 50+ users with PostgreSQL full-text search.
Containerised the service with Docker and set up a GitHub Actions pipeline running pytest on every pull request.
